import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import RidgeClassifier
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")


# Light text preprocessing
def preprocess_text(text):
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    return text.strip()


train_df["text"] = train_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["text"] = test_df["text"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Stratified train/validation split with 10% validation set
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["text"],
    train_df["author"],
    test_size=0.10,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["author"],
)

# TF-IDF vectorization with expanded feature space
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.90,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    strip_accents="unicode",
)

X_train_full_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_val_tfidf = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"])

# Ridge classifier with isotonic calibration (using SAG solver as described)
base_clf = RidgeClassifier(alpha=1.2, solver="sag", random_state=42)
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="isotonic", cv=3)

# Fit the model
clf.fit(X_train_full_tfidf, y_train_full)

# Predict on validation set and compute log loss
val_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)
val_logloss = log_loss(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation log loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = sample_sub.copy()
submission_df["EAP"] = test_preds[:, 0]
submission_df["HPL"] = test_preds[:, 1]
submission_df["MWS"] = test_preds[:, 2]

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
